name: California State Lands Commission
coverageNote: Statewide body; only Tahoe-related items get summaries. Minutes are not posted separately; the webcast is on CAL-SPAN.

participation.instructions: Attend in person or watch the live webcast on CAL-SPAN. To speak in person or virtually, fill out the electronic Request to Speak form on the Commission's homepage once staff reports are published (generally three minutes per speaker). Email written comments at least three business days before the meeting, with the agenda item number in the subject line.

itemScope.note: Most items are leases elsewhere in California, so only Tahoe items get staff reports and summaries. Each agenda row names the water body, the nearest town, and the county; every Lake Tahoe row says "Lake Tahoe", which "Tahoe" also matches in South Lake Tahoe, Tahoe City, Tahoe Vista, Tahoe Keys, and the Lake Tahoe Basin. The other terms are Tahoe and Truckee places named without the word. El Dorado, Placer, and Nevada County alone do not qualify: those counties reach Folsom Lake, the American River, and the Sacramento Valley edge, and their Tahoe rows always name the lake too. The Commission has no Nevada jurisdiction, so Nevada shore names are not listed.
